research_notes: SOURCE ACCESS: every document was downloaded directly from www.banksinarmas.com on 2026-11-03 (no bot protection; no archive needed; idx.co.id not used). The IR pages (https://www.banksinarmas.com/id/informasiumum/hubunganinvestor/...) link disclosure/GMS files as .../keterbukaan-informasi/<file> or .../rapat-umum-pemegang-saham/<file>, which return an HTML page; the actual PDFs are served at https://www.banksinarmas.com/id/public/upload/file/<file> (the URLs in source_url, spaces encoded as %20).

ENTITY / BASIS: until 31 Dec 2023 the bank had no subsidiaries (its Sharia Business Unit, UUS, was a division), so FY2019-FY2023 statements are stand-alone and are the whole reporting entity (stored as 'consolidated'; equity_attr = total equity). On 1 Jan 2024 the UUS was spun off into PT Bank Nano Syariah (51% Bank Sinarmas, 25% PT Sinar Mas Multiartha Tbk, 24% PT Asuransi Sinar Mas; AR2025 PDF p. 644), consolidated from FY2024 with non-controlling interests (567,182 / 606,808). Since then the parent itself does no sharia business, so `sharia` is false. Group perimeter is therefore continuous (UUS 2019-2023 = Bank Nano Syariah 2024+).

RATIO BASIS: FY ratios are the AR 'Rasio Keuangan Penting' table (AR2025 PDF p. 14 for 2021-2025; AR2024 PDF p. 12 for 2020). For FY2024 and FY2025 that table is CONSOLIDATED (its CAR 30.46/33.98 equals the consolidated KPMM in the Dec 2024/Dec 2025 OJK published reports, whose bank-only KPMM is 31.26/35.23); bank-only values are quoted in each note. FY2020-FY2023 are the bank's individual ratios (no subsidiaries; FY2023 values equal the Dec 2024 published report's comparative). The 9M2026 interim ratios come from the OJK published report's ratio table, which is bank-only: interim and FY2024/25 ratios are on different bases.

CAR CONFLICTS: AR2025 prints FY2025 consolidated CAR 33.98% (highlights p. 14, solvency table p. 160, = Dec 2025 published report) but 33.55% in the MD&A ratio table (p. 158) and FS notes p. 743 (risk-management narrative); bank-only 35.20% in FS Note 28 (p. 720) vs 35.23% in the published report. The same Note prints bank-only 32.26% for 2024 although its components give 31.26%. FY2020: AR2020 printed 17.10%, later ARs and the FY2021 audited FS 17.29% (stored).

DEPOSITS DEFINITION: deposits = DPK including temporary syirkah deposits ('Dana syirkah temporer - simpanan' of the UUS / Bank Nano Syariah, Rp3.6-7.2tn), because loans include the sharia financing and the bank's own DPK total and CASA ratio use this definition. NOTE for comparability: BBNI.json excludes temporary syirkah deposits. Customer deposits excl. syirkah: 2025 39,878.344; 2024 37,897.415; 2023 35,142.585; 2022 32,397.026; 2021 37,961.555; 2020 30,763.916; 2019 24,652.197 (IDR bn).

LOANS DEFINITION: 'Kredit yang diberikan dan piutang/pembiayaan syariah' gross, excluding ijarah assets (separate line, 2025 gross 629.0bn). The bank's 'Kredit Gross' in the AR2025 market-share table (12,342 / 14,648) and the OJK-format consolidated 'Kredit yang diberikan' in some published reports include them.
